channel.title: IMAGINE YOU WERE THERE: Potential SCP
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "IMAGINE YOU WERE THERE: Potential SCP" - A sadistic man tells stories of violence; people who listen to the end suffer the fate of the characters

item.title: Re: IMAGINE YOU WERE THERE: Potential SCP
item.content:encoded:
+ Cope Crit
- Close

Okay, let's see what we have…. Beware. I'm blunt and straight to the point.

A sadistic man tells stories of violence and death. People who listen are entranced. However, as the story goes on, listeners start to show signs of physical trauma. When the man finishes his story, any wounds inflicted on the characters in the story appear on the listener, often killing them.

Okay, so he's a sadistic human that uses mind affecting abilities. I got that. But why? Why does he kill people? Why does he do what he does?

The concept is introduced in the Containment Procedures and Description. The SCP is relatively easy to contain, except that his anomalous abilities increase over time unless he is given a D-class to tell a story to. If he is not sated within 8 days, his anomalous abilities begin to work over video, radio, and recordings. If he cannot tell anyone a story in 15 days, he will begin to project mental images of torture and killing into the minds of people outside his containment. After 21 days, this starts to cause minor but real physical damage to those affected. After 28 days, he mentally projects his image of agony onto everyone within several kilometers, which kills most of those affected.

Okay, so you've talked about how his ability increases every day and it eventually kills people within several kilometers. How long does this last? Does it reset? Does it stay in a several kilometer range until it's finished? Either way, why don't they just lock him up in an cell outside that radius and just use other means to research the subject?

The SCP was discovered and contained after a series of anomalous murders in Tokyo. The SCP seems to understand more about its powers than the Foundation does, and has caused a number of incidents and containment breaches.

It sounds like he's just here to be a headache for the Foundation and nothing more, which brings me to my next thing.

In an interview, the SCP recounts its childhood psychopathy, its path to becoming a serial killer, and how it attained its anomalous abilities.

Care to expand on that? Up to this point you've only explained how much of a danger this guy is and his abilities. You haven't really talked about the narrative in any great detail.

Overall thoughts: Other then the fact that anomalous human affecting people's mind has been done before, this doesn't seem to have any unique concept. Just dangerous to be dangerous. You hinted at a story, but to no detail. Some of the points didn't seem to be needed either, like;

The concept is introduced in the Containment Procedures and Description.

What concept? The narrative? The abilities? I'm not sure what you're referring to.

If you could clear some stuff up, I could look over it again.

- Close
